title: 频谱铸场 / Spectral Foundry
author: Rhythm Master
license_status: First-party composition; existing attributed scene/math/BRDF adapters; outbound license pending

descriptions.zh-CN: 4096 根共享网格音柱直接响应真实频段，三重铜色轨道环绕。双灯光、金属材质、浮点柔光与显式 SDR 映射；响度控制焦点，独立深度节点可预览，静音回落，全部节点可编辑。
descriptions.en-US: 4096 shared-mesh columns respond to real bands inside three copper orbits. Two lights, metallic shading, floating-point bloom and explicit SDR mapping. Loudness controls focus; inspect captured depth, edit every node and watch silence lower the columns.
